description: Two pinned ViewGroup executions replayed per pinned module: ViewGroupObjectArrayEvent (ord 0) object-array events over groupwin(p1)#length(2) pinning the per-group sum(p2) Long evolution 10/21/33/36 through istream-only listener records, and ViewGroupLengthWin (ord 14) groupwin(theString)#length(3) pinning istream-only delivery until each group window fills then irstream pairs evicting E2/20 and E1/1; suite milestones record nothing and the suite's AnyOrder iterator assertions stay unpinned; ViewGroupMultiProperty (ord 6, groupwin(symbol, feed, volume)#uni(price)) is deferred from this unit because #uni is a per-group derived-value view delivering irstream pairs whose old row is the previous datapoints, which the Go fluent adaptation (select aggregate over a keepall group window) cannot express yet, the same adaptation gap class as ViewGroup ords 1/4/5
